def.zh-tw: 地球氣候較冷、高緯度與高山地區的冰層大幅擴張的時期；在地球過去的歷史中，冰期與間冰期反覆交替。
def.en: A time when Earth's climate is colder and the ice at high latitudes and on high mountains spreads widely; in Earth's past, glacial and interglacial periods have taken turns again and again.

def.zh-tw: 兩次冰期之間，氣候較溫暖、冰層退縮的時期。
def.en: The warmer time between two glacial periods, when the ice retreats.

source.locator: 樂詞網 間冰期 interglacial period
